milestone: M2 compiler-aware control recovery, using the M0 fixed development input and the checked M1 region/storage boundary
status: Exploratory fixture-specific candidate; normal CLI and fresh holdout outputs retain the preceding M0 checkpoint results.
question: Can a loop recover three compiler-expanded lanes while retaining the peeled direct-index load, memory order and early exits, and improve source topology under the same metric?
result: Yes for the fixed Clang18 O2 development object. A completed three-round model proves the explicit region contract with a15second diagnostic solver budget. The same formula is unknown under5seconds. Source topology distance30to13 and goto15to8; this is evidence for candidate generation, not a general recovery pass.

input.provenance: Exact13-register printed storage lowering, runtime literal reconstruction asserted byte-for-byte against the retained verified IR. Source lowering lineage is recorded in the baseline checkpoint.

omitted_registers.10: Index scratch never read before redefinition after any source continuation.
omitted_registers.13: Fresh counter absent from original13-register source; padded arbitrary source slot is never read.

contract.input_facts: Source ValueWidths entry caps are independently rechecked by extraction. The candidate applies those masks at the region entry. Its feedback accepts unrestricted words and receives correlations from its actual prefix.
contract.observations: Decoded continuation or return, all RAM, first fault address/access/width, and declared registers on normal exits.
contract.separate_observations: Guest PC, trace, instruction budget and registers at a fault are outside the equivalence query. Whole-function C comparison is concrete validation, distinct from the region proof.
contract.completion: Prefix entry32, feedback501, three unfolded feedback iterations; raw unrestricted UNSAT required before comparing the completed DAG.
contract.candidate_recipe: Keep the peeled first direct-index load. Use (i+j)&3 only for remaining lanes and invariant xor(i+1). Preserve the distinct last-lane mark update at the shared exit. Retain unreachable source instructions during this pilot.

queries.negative_control: Replace invariant xor(i+1) with xor(i+j); Counterexample replayed by the Rust region verifier.

validation.generated_c_observations: Return, every byte of512-byte RAM, first fault; UBSan enabled. Five addresses include valid, stack-overlapping, below-base, beyond-end and u64::MAX.

reproduction.launcher_python:
"""Replay the archived development candidate in a managed temporary directory."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--out', required=True, type=Path)
p.add_argument('--checkpoint', default='tools/corpora/loop-unroll-clang18-v1.m2-trial.json', type=Path)
a = p.parse_args()
a.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
a.out = a.out.resolve()
root = Path.cwd()
record = json.loads(a.checkpoint.read_text())
files = record['reproduction']['files']
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
for name, item in files.items():
    assert sha(item['text'].encode()) == item['sha256'], name
    (a.out / name).write_text(item['text'])
test = root / 'tests/verification/region_extraction.rs'
original = test.read_bytes()
assert sha(original) == record['source_hashes']['tests/verification/region_extraction.rs']
solver = Path(os.environ['NIRVANA_Z3']).resolve()
assert sha(solver.read_bytes()) == record['toolchain']['z3_sha256']
reports = []
try:
    for name in ['negative-5.rs', 'positive-c-15.rs']:
        directory = a.out / name.removesuffix('.rs')
        directory.mkdir()
        text = files[name]['text']
        text = text.replace('/home/hosi/nirvana/tests/support/', str(root / 'tests/support') + '/')
        text = text.replace('include!(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/.git/nirvana-actual-loop-source.rs"));', 'include!(r#"' + str(a.out / 'source-ir.rs') + '"#);')
        text = text.replace('"target/checkpoints/ir-entry-storage-v1/printed-storage.ir.txt"', 'r#"' + str(a.out / 'source.ir') + '"#')
        pilot = directory / 'pilot.rs'
        pilot.write_text(text)
        test.write_bytes(original + ('\nmod storage_pilot { include!(r#"' + str(pilot) + '"#); }\n').encode())
        result = subprocess.run(['python3', 'tools/dev.py', 'cargo', 'test', '--test', 'verification', 'actual_expanded_loop_candidate_pilot', '--', '--ignored', '--nocapture', '--test-threads=1'], env=os.environ | {'NIRVANA_Z3': str(solver), 'NIRVANA_LOOP_OUT': str(directory)}, capture_output=True, text=True)
        log = result.stdout + result.stderr
        (directory / 'run.log').write_text(log)
        assert result.returncode == 0, log
        assert sha((directory / 'compare-false.smt2').read_bytes()) == record['queries']['comparison_sha256']
        assert sha((directory / 'complete-false.smt2').read_bytes()) == record['queries']['completion_sha256']
        if name.startswith('negative'):
            assert 'wrong=true completion=complete' in log and 'compare=counterexample_replayed' in log, log
            assert sha((directory / 'compare-true.smt2').read_bytes()) == record['queries']['negative_comparison_sha256']
        else:
            assert 'compare=equivalent' in log, log
            for optimization in ['-O0', '-O2']:
                assert f'opt={optimization} cases=325 full_ram=true faults=true ubsan=true' in log, log
            assert sha((directory / 'candidate.c').read_bytes()) == record['quality']['candidate']['c_sha256']
        reports.append({'trial': name, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'log_sha256': sha(log.encode())})
finally:
    test.write_bytes(original)
assert test.read_bytes() == original
for name in ['parse-ir.py', 'audit-exits.py']:
    script = (a.out / name).read_text().replace('target/checkpoints/ir-entry-storage-v1', str(a.out))
    (a.out / name).write_text(script)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(a.out / name)], check=True)
audit = json.loads((a.out / 'exit-read-audit.json').read_text())
assert audit == record['exit_read_audit']
if 'NIRVANA_CLANG18' in os.environ:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tools'))
    from evaluation import control_graph as cg
    clang = Path(os.environ['NIRVANA_CLANG18']).resolve()
    result = subprocess.run([str(clang), '--analyze', '-std=c11', '-Werror', '-Xclang', '-analyzer-checker=debug.DumpCFG', str(a.out / 'positive-c-15/candidate.c'), '-o', os.devnull], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    raw, stats = cg.parse_dump(result.stderr, 'nirvana_readable')
    graph, removed = cg.normalize(raw)
    source = cg.graph_from_json(json.loads(files['source-cfg.json']['text'])['graph'])
    distance = cg.distance(source, graph, max_states=100000, seconds=1.0)
    assert distance['status'] == 'exact' and distance['upper_bound'] == 13, distance
    assert stats['gotos'] == 8, stats
    (a.out / 'quality.json').write_text(json.dumps({'distance': distance, 'stats': stats | removed}, indent=2) + '\n')
(a.out / 'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps({'trials': reports, 'source_restored': True}, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(reports, indent=2))
